## Checks

- [ ] I did all checks in `CONTRIBUTING.md`, and they pass.
- [ ] I added a changeset, or the change does not need one.
- [ ] I added or changed tests for the change.
- [ ] I added or changed the documentation for the change.

## STE checklist

Vale cannot check these rules. Examine all new prose, TSDoc and runtime messages.

- [ ] Each procedure sentence has a maximum of 20 words.
- [ ] Each procedure sentence gives one instruction in the imperative.
- [ ] Each sentence has one topic.
- [ ] Each word refers to one thing only. The text uses the same word for the same thing.
- [ ] Each technical name is an approved name from the glossary.
- [ ] Each new technical name is in `.vale/styles/config/vocabularies/STE/accept.txt`.
- [ ] A verb is a verb, not a noun or an adjective.
- [ ] The text uses the simple tenses only.
- [ ] A warning or a caution comes before the step that it applies to.
- [ ] Each code sample is in `docs/snippets/`, and each inline code block has a maximum of 3 lines.
